info.name: Team-BHP Forum
info.description:
Transform your Team-BHP forum reading experience with this minimalist style that focuses on readability and modern design.

Features:

Centered Content Layout: Posts are constrained to a comfortable 1200px max-width and centered for better readability on wide monitors

Modern Typography: Uses clean system fonts (Inter, SF Pro, Segoe UI) for a crisp, contemporary look

Fully Responsive: Automatically adjusts to 90% width on smaller screens with appropriate padding

What This Style Does:
Prevents posts from stretching across ultra-wide monitors, creates a comfortable reading width similar to modern blog layouts, maintains the forum's original design while improving readability, and works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Perfect for anyone who finds the default forum layout too wide or wants a cleaner, more focused reading experience on Team-BHP. Simple, lightweight, and non-intrusive. Just better readability.
